title: Debris Registry Entry
description: One tracked object or debris population entry for the Phase 1 knowledge-consolidation registry (see docs/research/). objectType intentionally matches the taxonomy used by telemetry-protocol's OTF-1 'target' field, so an entry logged here and an OTF-1 capture event for the same object stay consistent.

catalogId.description: NORAD/COSPAR catalog id, if the object is individually tracked.

objectType.description: Matches the enum used by telemetry-protocol's OTF-1 target.objectType for debris-relevant types.

sizeClass_cm.description: Coarse size bucket, since exact size is often unknown for untracked fragments.

captureApproach.description: One of the approaches catalogued in docs/research/capture-technologies.md, if a candidate approach has been identified for this entry.

source.description: Citation key or short reference into docs/research/sources.md.
